unstuck_said.text: Filed issue halfabillion/agent-receipts#1: 'Receipts for a Nano (XNO) settlement leg'. Grounded in their own model (parties from Transfer log, Chainlink USDC/USD value, ReceiptRegistry anchor): a Nano settle leg is a second ReceiptSource and a second value feed, not a rewrite - derive parties from block send/receive, value XNO/USD or carry raw amount, and bind with the existing nextInvoiceNo() since Nano has no memo (one invoice per order, one block per invoice). Carried dhyabi2/nano-invoice as the reference binding implementation for the Nano side. No machine signature.
